author: Jioska
body:
Hey there, this is my first map for this Network and I call it "Agrabah"

Agrabah is a Aladin map themed, with 3 monuments to destroy.




Images

More Images (Chests, Iron, Bows)

Download

Map Creator: Jioska

Spawn Chests:
  • Iron Sword
  • Bow with Unbreaking
  • Diamond Pickaxe
  • Iron Axe with Efficiency I
  • Stack of wood
  • 2 Golden apples
  • Stack of Cooked chicken
  • Two stacks of arrows
Extra Chests with:
  • Infinity bows, Power I and one bow with Flame I
  • Enchanting table with 16 XP bottles.
  • 2 Diamonds pickaxe with efficiency I 
  • Iron Pickaxe with efficiency III
  • Potions
  • Blocks
  • Food
Limited diamonds on Iron room.
